registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Firmware control register. Bit 0-1 select operating mode. Bit 2 is a command-valid strobe written by firmware to request a new control action. Bit 3 selects hold-last-safe fallback behavior. Bit 4 requests fault clear. Bit 5 acknowledges sticky IRQ causes. Bits 8-15 enable interrupt sources. All other bits are reserved and read as zero.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Operating mode selection. Scalar control-policy mode programmed by firmware.

fields.name: cmd_valid
fields.description: Firmware command-accept strobe. Writing 1 requests acceptance of the current configuration snapshot by the control core.

fields.name: hold_last_safe
fields.description: When set, safe fallback holds the last known safe actuator command instead of driving the programmed safe-state command.

fields.name: fault_clear
fields.description: Write 1 to request clearing of latched fault state, subject to controller validity conditions.

fields.name: irq_ack
fields.description: Write 1 to acknowledge and clear sticky interrupt causes that are eligible to be cleared.

fields.name: irq_enable
fields.description: Interrupt enable mask. Each bit enables the corresponding sticky interrupt source in IRQ_STATUS.

registers.name: VELOCITY_Q8_8
registers.description: Programmed vehicle velocity input in Q8.8 fixed-point format. The control core validates this against the configured operating envelope before actuator updates are allowed.

fields.name: velocity_q8_8
fields.description: Velocity scalar in Q8.8 format. Reset value corresponds to the nominal reference condition of 38.89 m/s.

registers.name: GEOMETRY_HANDLE
registers.description: Opaque geometry descriptor handle used by firmware to reference off-chip model context. No geometry payload is stored in RTL.

fields.name: geometry_handle
fields.description: Opaque handle for the external aerodynamic service.

registers.name: SEQ_CTRL
registers.description: Sequence control register. Firmware seeds or programs the next request sequence number in bits 0-15. Bits 16-31 expose the last accepted sequence number for readback.

fields.name: request_seq
fields.description: Firmware-programmed request sequence seed or expected next sequence number.

fields.name: last_accepted_seq_ro
fields.description: Last accepted request sequence number returned by the control core.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_AND_ENVELOPE
registers.description: Timeout threshold and envelope limits. Timeout is measured in controller ticks. Velocity limits define the allowed operating envelope around the 20 to 55 m/s region.

fields.name: timeout_threshold
fields.description: Deterministic timeout threshold in controller ticks. When age exceeds this value, the core enters safe fallback.

fields.name: velocity_low_limit
fields.description: Lower programmed velocity limit used by envelope validation. Intended to correspond to the lower edge of the allowed operating envelope.

fields.name: velocity_high_limit
fields.description: Upper programmed velocity limit used by envelope validation. Intended to correspond to the upper edge of the allowed operating envelope.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_LIMITS
registers.description: Actuator clamp configuration. Output commands are saturated between these bounds before being presented to the actuator interface.

fields.name: actuator_min
fields.description: Lower actuator clamp value.

fields.name: actuator_max
fields.description: Upper actuator clamp value.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_SLEW
registers.description: Programmable per-update slew cap used to rate-limit actuator command changes.

fields.name: actuator_slew
fields.description: Maximum absolute actuator delta permitted per update.

registers.name: SAFE_STATE
registers.description: Safe fallback configuration. The controller drives this actuator command on faults unless hold-last-safe is enabled.

fields.name: safe_state_cmd
fields.description: Deterministic safe actuator command.

registers.name: STATUS0
registers.description: Primary status summary. Exposes outstanding request, safe-state indication, fault latch, actuator-valid, and fault code.

fields.name: outstanding_req
fields.description: 1 when a request is outstanding and awaiting response acceptance.

fields.name: status_safe_state
fields.description: 1 when the controller is in safe fallback state.

fields.name: status_fault_latched
fields.description: Latched fault indication.

fields.name: status_actuator_valid
fields.description: 1 when the presented actuator command is valid for actuation.

fields.name: status_fault_code
fields.description: Encoded fault reason. Code values are implementation-defined but deterministic.

registers.name: STATUS1
registers.description: Event counters for timeout and stale response rejection.

fields.name: status_timeout_count
fields.description: Count of deterministic timeout events.

fields.name: status_stale_reject_count
fields.description: Count of stale, late, duplicated, malformed, or mismatched responses rejected by the core.

fields.name: status_invalid_env_count
fields.description: Count of envelope violations where velocity was outside the programmed limits.

fields.name: status_age_counter
fields.description: Age of the outstanding request in controller ticks.

fields.name: status_last_accepted_seq
fields.description: Last accepted request sequence number.

fields.name: status_response_seq
fields.description: Last accepted response sequence number.

registers.name: STATUS4
registers.description: Lower 32 bits of the last launched request word.

fields.name: status_last_req_word_lo
fields.description: Lower 32 bits of the last 64-bit request word sent to the external service.

registers.name: STATUS5
registers.description: Upper 32 bits of the last launched request word.

fields.name: status_last_req_word_hi
fields.description: Upper 32 bits of the last 64-bit request word sent to the external service.

registers.name: STATUS6
registers.description: Lower 32 bits of the last observed response word.

fields.name: status_last_resp_word_lo
fields.description: Lower 32 bits of the last 64-bit response word accepted or observed by the controller.

registers.name: STATUS7
registers.description: Upper 32 bits of the last observed response word.

fields.name: status_last_resp_word_hi
fields.description: Upper 32 bits of the last 64-bit response word accepted or observed by the controller.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.description: Sticky interrupt status register. Writing 1 to a bit clears that sticky cause.

fields.name: resp_ready_sticky
fields.description: Sticky interrupt cause for response-ready or response-accepted events.

fields.name: timeout_sticky
fields.description: Sticky interrupt cause for timeout expiration.

fields.name: stale_reject_sticky
fields.description: Sticky interrupt cause for stale or mismatched response rejection.

fields.name: invalid_env_sticky
fields.description: Sticky interrupt cause for invalid velocity envelope.

fields.name: fault_clear_event
fields.description: Sticky interrupt cause indicating that firmware requested a fault-clear event.

registers.name: FAULT_STATUS
registers.description: Latched fault summary and safe-state indication.

fields.name: fault_code
fields.description: Latched fault code.

fields.name: fault_latched
fields.description: 1 when a fault is currently latched.

fields.name: safe_state
fields.description: 1 when safe fallback is currently active.
